beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you look over the walking route, Elliot recognises you and rests a finger beside the map, leaving the page clear.
beats.chinese: 你正看着散步路线，埃利奥特认出了你，把手指停在地图旁，没有挡住页面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good to see you. I made plum jam and labelled it 'traffic jam'. Nobody at work laughed. A very difficult audience.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。我做了李子果酱，给它贴上‘交通堵塞’的标签——英语里都叫 jam。同事一个也没笑。这届观众可真难带。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Elliot taps the map's route key once, then gives his own joke a reluctant thumbs-down.
beats.chinese: 埃利奥特点了一下地图的路线图例，不情不愿地给自己的笑话比了个拇指向下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One out of ten. But the actual jam was good. I have independent reports on that.
beats.chinese: 十分里得一分吧。不过果酱确实不错。这可是有别人作证的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You pause over your notes as Maya approaches the shared view of the bridge. She recognises you and gives a small wave.
beats.chinese: 你在笔记前停了停，玛雅走到能望见桥的位置，认出你后轻轻挥了挥手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I wrote 'metal gate' in my sound notes, then spent twenty minutes wondering which gate. Excellent work from me.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。我在声音笔记里写了‘铁门’，然后花了二十分钟琢磨究竟是哪扇门。我可真行。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Maya opens her own notebook to show a tiny sketch of a gate beneath two crossed-out street names.
beats.chinese: 玛雅翻开自己的本子，指给你看：两个划掉的街道名下面，画着一扇小门。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Found it in the end. The drawing helped more than my description. I'm keeping both, despite the terrible drawing.
beats.chinese: 最后还是找到了。画比文字管用。两样我都留着，虽然这画实在不怎么样。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: While you write beside the pond, Ruth notices the postcard and recognises you. She stops at a comfortable distance from the ledge.
beats.chinese: 你在池边写字时，露丝注意到明信片，也认出了你。她在离石台适当的位置停下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. My music software keeps offering me a button called 'humanise'. Thirty-one years recording actual humans, and now a button knows better.
beats.chinese: 你好。我的音乐软件老给我一个叫‘人性化’的按钮。记了三十一年真人说的话，现在倒是一个按钮更懂人了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ruth sets her blank card on her knee and taps a perfectly even rhythm against its corner.
beats.chinese: 露丝把空白卡片放在膝上，指尖在卡角打出均匀的节拍。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I tried it. The drums got slightly late. I could have done that myself.
beats.chinese: 我试了。鼓点变得稍微迟了一点。这事我自己也会。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You offer a napkin as Morgan puts away a damp pouch. They recognise you and accept one before placing the pouch aside.
beats.chinese: 摩根收起一个潮湿的小袋时，你询问是否需要纸巾。认出你后，他们接了一张，把袋子放到一旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Hello again. That's water, fortunately. Clay dust would just turn to mud if I rubbed it like this.
beats.chinese: 谢谢，又见面了。幸好沾的是水。要是陶土粉，像这样擦反倒会变成泥。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Morgan pats the pouch dry, then notices a table-football score written on the back of their hand and curls their fingers over it.
beats.chinese: 摩根把袋子轻轻按干，瞥见自己手背上写着的桌上足球比分，又蜷起手指想把它挡住。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Friendly match. We weren't keeping score. I was keeping a very small amount of score.
beats.chinese: 友谊赛，大家不计分。我只计了那么一小点分。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You are considering the pond in your sketchbook when Daniel recognises you. He stays beside the ledge without leaning over your page.
beats.chinese: 你正对着速写本琢磨池塘的画法，丹尼尔认出了你。他站在石台旁，没有俯身去看你的纸页。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I used a ruler for a sketch at home. Found out afterwards it was the wrong side. I had invented several new centimetres.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。我在家画速写时用了把尺子，后来才发现看错刻度面了。凭空发明了好几种新厘米。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Daniel holds his pencil over his own page, measures a gap with his thumb and gives up with a small shrug.
beats.chinese: 丹尼尔在自己的纸页上悬着铅笔，用拇指比了比一段距离，又轻轻耸肩放弃了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Strictly speaking, the picture still looked like a pond. I'm accepting that result.
beats.chinese: 严格说来，那画看着还是个池塘。这个结果，我接受。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You turn towards the rain on the cafe window as Aisha recognises you from a nearby seat and gives a brief nod.
beats.chinese: 你望向咖啡馆窗上的雨，邻座的艾莎认出了你，轻轻点了点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I've named my new scent 'Number Six'. The first five names were longer than the label.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。我给新香味取名叫‘六号’。前五个名字都比标签还长。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aisha turns a closed tin in her hands, showing a small handwritten 6, and returns it to her pocket without opening it.
beats.chinese: 艾莎转了转手里盖着的铁盒，露出手写的小小数字六，没打开就放回了口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No samples in a cafe. People ordered coffee, not my experiments. Number Six can wait.
beats.chinese: 咖啡馆里就不试香了。大家点的是咖啡，不是我的实验品。六号可以等等。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You ask whether Simon would like a pastry. He recognises you, smiles, and politely declines before settling beside the table.
beats.chinese: 你询问西蒙要不要尝一块点心。他认出了你，笑着婉拒，然后在桌旁坐稳。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No pastry for me, thanks. Hello again. I gave a puppet a little clockwork mouth. Now it chews through all its serious speeches.
beats.chinese: 我就不吃点心了，谢谢。又见面了。我给一只木偶装了个小发条嘴，现在它每次严肃发言都像在嚼东西。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Simon presses his lips together, then demonstrates one tiny chewing movement and stops, visibly amused.
beats.chinese: 西蒙抿了抿嘴，示范了一下小小的咀嚼动作就停住了，自己也忍不住笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm rewriting it as a hungry king. Easier than arguing with the mechanism.
beats.chinese: 我准备把它改成一个饿着肚子的国王。比跟机关较劲省事。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You take a sip of coffee while looking towards the bridge. Nora recognises you and stops nearby without interrupting the view.
beats.chinese: 你喝了一口咖啡，望着远处的桥。诺拉认出了你，在旁边停下，没有挡住视线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I've found the radio I wanted. Same model, wrong colour. Apparently I had very strong opinions about brown without knowing it.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。我找到想要的那台收音机了。型号对，颜色不对。原来我对棕色有这么大的意见，自己都没发现。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Nora settles her bag at her feet and holds her hands apart to indicate a radio wider than the bag.
beats.chinese: 诺拉把包放在脚边，双手比画了一下，收音机比她的包还宽。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Left it there. It would have taken over the kitchen table. I still need somewhere to eat.
beats.chinese: 没买。搬回去就要霸占厨房桌子了。我还得有个地方吃饭。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you look at the reflections, Alex recognises you near the pond. They stop beside the ledge and follow the changing outline.
beats.chinese: 你看着水中倒影时，池边的亚历克斯认出了你。他们停在石台旁，沿着变化的轮廓望过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Look—hello again. I was so busy watching the reflection that I nearly walked past you. I do that with people. Sorry.
beats.chinese: 看——啊，又见面了。我刚顾着看倒影，差点就从你身边走过去了。我对人有时会这样，不好意思。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Alex moves their binoculars into their bag and turns away from the water, giving you their full attention.
beats.chinese: 亚历克斯把望远镜放进包里，转身不再看水面，认真面向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Equipment away. Otherwise I say I'm listening and start adjusting a little wheel. Very convincing of me.
beats.chinese: 好了，东西收起来。否则我嘴上说在听，手又开始拧小轮子。可真有说服力。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: While you look over the map, Victor recognises you and pauses beside the table, keeping his hands clear of the marked paths.
beats.chinese: 你查看地图时，维克托认出了你，在桌旁停下，没有把手放到标出的路线上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I sewed a coat pocket shut by mistake. Told the costume shop it was a security feature.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。我不小心把一件大衣的口袋缝死了，还跟戏服店说那是防盗设计。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Victor starts to laugh, then raises one finger to interrupt his own story before looking back at the map.
beats.chinese: 维克托刚笑起来，又竖起一根手指打断自己的故事，然后才看回地图。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Here's the honest bit: I only thought of that line on the bus home. At the shop I just said sorry and unpicked it.
beats.chinese: 说实话吧：这话是坐公交回家时才想到的。在店里我只说了对不起，然后把线拆了。
